row.title: Workers AI for the executor goes through the site Worker's OIDC route (AI-OIDC-1)
row.body: The repo's Cloudflare secrets name the retired account and cfaccount strips them, so every workers-ai rung was unavailable. With id-token: write, a workers-ai rung with no Cloudflare secret calls /__internal/cf with ai/run/@cf/<model>, an allow-listed path in site/deployer.js.
